newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank sees room for higher 97 div.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank sees room for higher 97 div.

text.p: Germany's Commerzbank AG said on Friday it saw scope for a dividend increase in 1997 if its business continued to develop well during the year.

"I believe we can be confident that, given continued good business during the course of the year, the management board will be able to propose room for manoeuvre for the dividend to the supervisory board," chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen told shareholders at the group's annual shareholders meeting.
Commerzbank's operating profit before risk provisions rose 20.5 percent in the first quarter of 1997. It held its dividend for 1996 unchanged at 1.35 per share.
